module reg_if_08 (
  input clk,
  input rst_n,
  input [7:0] in_data,
  output [7:0] out_data
);
  reg [7:0] reg_file [0:255];
  reg [7:0] addr_ptr;
  reg [7:0] current_data;

  always @(posedge clk or negedge rst_n) begin
    if (!rst_n) begin
      addr_ptr <= 8'd0;
      current_data <= 8'd0;
    end else begin
      addr_ptr <= addr_ptr + 8'd1;
      current_data <= reg_file[addr_ptr];
    end
  end

  assign out_data = current_data;

  // This block is for updating the register file with new data
  always @(posedge clk or negedge rst_n) begin
    if (!rst_n) begin
      reg_file[0] <= 8'd0;
    end else begin
      reg_file[addr_ptr] <= in_data;
    end
  end
endmodule
